config.label: The Bootr site to talk to
config.description: The Bootr site to talk to. Leave it unset for bootr.fun.

config.label: Where the server keeps the connection to a coin's agent after you approve it in the browser
config.description: Where the server keeps the connection to a coin's agent after you approve it in the browser. Unset, it is ~/.config/bootr/credentials.json (%APPDATA%\bootr\credentials.json on Windows), readable by you only. Give a full path: ~ is not expanded.

config.label: The only folder a picture for a post can be uploaded from
config.description: The only folder a picture for a post can be uploaded from. Unset, it is bootr-pictures in your home folder. Give a full path: ~ is not expanded.
